name: QQ Mail
description: Connect QQ Mail to read, search, send, reply to, forward, and delete messages, and retrieve attachments.
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP endpoint
configuration.endpoint.description: The official QQ Mail Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Keep the default value.
authorization.title: Authorize a QQ Mail account
authorization.description: Complete OAuth authorization on the official QQ Mail page. POCO will not ask for your password or token in chat.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.read.title: Read messages
capabilities.read.description: Browse inbox, sent, trash, and spam folders and read message bodies.
capabilities.search.title: Search messages
capabilities.search.description: Search by keyword, sender, recipient, date, folder, and attachment status.
capabilities.send.title: Handle messages
capabilities.send.description: Send new messages and reply to or forward existing messages.
capabilities.attachments.title: Retrieve attachments
capabilities.attachments.description: List message attachments and download supported attachment content.
capabilities.safety.title: Operation confirmation
capabilities.safety.description: POCO shows the parameters and requests confirmation before sending, replying, forwarding, or deleting.
examples.title: Examples
examples.unread.title: Review unread mail
examples.unread.description: Review the latest 20 unread messages and summarize them by importance.
examples.search.title: Find earlier messages
examples.search.description: Find messages from last month with “project report” in the subject.
examples.reply.title: Reply to a message
examples.reply.description: Read the latest customer message, draft a reply, and send it after confirmation.
